summary: Scope MiMo paged-decode and block-FP8 GEMV compile reuse to preparation jobs
compatibility: No user action required. Prepared calls retain their compiled programs after the preparation cache is cleared.
details: Paged-decode and block-FP8 GEMV factories share compiled programs within a preparation job and release the factory cache with that job.
Block-FP8 GEMV reuses one compiled callable across live row counts without a process-wide factory cache.
